steps.script: (async () => { const r = await fetch('/api/auth/login', {method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}, credentials:'same-origin', body: JSON.stringify({username:'bootstrap_admin', password:'ChangeThisBootstrapPass_2026!'})}); const j = await r.json().catch(()=>({})); return { status: r.status, ok: !!j.ok }; })()
steps.label: login_via_api

steps.script: (() => { let n=0; document.querySelectorAll('link[rel=stylesheet]').forEach(l => { if (l.href.includes('/static/')) { l.href = l.href.split('?')[0] + '?cb=' + performance.now(); n++; } }); return { reloaded: n }; })()
steps.label: bust_css_cache

steps.script: (() => { const t = document.getElementById('attachSidePanelSuffixToggle'); const opt = document.getElementById('attachSidePanelSuffixOpt'); const names = [...document.querySelectorAll('.attach-list-item-name-text')].map(e => e.textContent.trim()); const r = opt.getBoundingClientRect(); return { checked: t.checked, hidden: opt.classList.contains('hidden'), label: opt.textContent.trim(), width: Math.round(r.width), height: Math.round(r.height), filenames: names }; })()
steps.label: T2_default_checked_and_filenames

steps.script: (() => { const m = document.querySelector('.attach-manage-backdrop .attach-manage-suffix input'); return { modalChecked: m.checked, matchesPanel: m.checked === document.getElementById('attachSidePanelSuffixToggle').checked }; })()
steps.label: T5_modal_reflects_panel_state

steps.script: (() => { const bd = document.querySelector('.attach-manage-backdrop'); const em = bd.querySelector('.attach-manage-suffix em'); const allEm = bd.querySelector("input[value='all']").closest('.attach-manage-choice').querySelector('em'); const box = bd.querySelector('.share-mgr-panel').getBoundingClientRect(); return { hint: em.textContent, ariaLive: em.getAttribute('aria-live'), scopeAllHint: allEm.textContent, modalH: Math.round(box.height) }; })()
steps.label: T6_both_hints_agree

steps.script: (() => { const bd = document.querySelector('.attach-manage-backdrop'); const allEm = bd.querySelector("input[value='all']").closest('.attach-manage-choice').querySelector('em'); const box = bd.querySelector('.share-mgr-panel').getBoundingClientRect(); return { modalChecked: bd.querySelector('.attach-manage-suffix input').checked, panelChecked: document.getElementById('attachSidePanelSuffixToggle').checked, stored: localStorage.getItem('dqa.attachDownloadVersionSuffix'), hint: bd.querySelector('.attach-manage-suffix em').textContent, scopeAllHint: allEm.textContent, modalH: Math.round(box.height) }; })()
steps.label: T8_reverse_sync_panel_follows_modal

steps.script: (async () => { const r = await fetch('/api/conversations/20260806062717-1d8ed346/attachments/download?format=manifest&scope=all&version_suffix=strip', {credentials:'same-origin'}); const j = await r.json(); const r2 = await fetch('/api/conversations/20260806062717-1d8ed346/attachments/download?format=manifest&scope=all&version_suffix=force', {credentials:'same-origin'}); const j2 = await r2.json(); return { strip: (j.files||[]).map(f => f.download_filename), force: (j2.files||[]).map(f => f.download_filename), stored: (j.files||[]).map(f => f.filename) }; })()
steps.label: T9_manifest_names_strip_vs_force

steps.script: (async () => { const r = await fetch('/api/conversations/20260806062717-1d8ed346/attachments/download?format=manifest&scope=all&version_suffix=bogus', {credentials:'same-origin'}); return { status: r.status }; })()
